data.understand: The job in itself is to be part of a team but also understand that as an individual you have lots to do for yourself and the team. The finish line is always changing, and each small step was the previous finish line, I can relate this to when you are creating something like a game or a book you have multiple steps to complete before reaching the end. The end can be the beginning of the next project.
data.offer: I believe that I bring organization and leadership to a team, I like to stay organized and make sure that we all can access what we need to and when we need to. Id say that my leadership skills are something that I can contribute, and have previously contributed in past projects. In the Slideshow, Lov3rs Plaza, and Sharksweeper projects I have been the team leader and have been in charge of setting up and distributing the work load to the correct individuals based on their skills. I had been in charge of managing the main repository making sure that assignments get done in time for submission.
data.limits: I think that my knowledge in coding would be classified as basic, meaning that I have been brushing up in my skills and trying more solo projects to further those skills. I think that understanding the code is important but so is understanding the story.

I dont have a set work schedule so somedays I open others I close, I can be contacted and can respond at any time
data.tools: Some of the most useful tools that I will be using are Youtube, Spotify and A.I such as Gemini and Chatgpt. I would say that these tools are important to me because I have learned so much from youtube, I dont have to stay with one way of understanding things because there is always another video that will teach it differently. Music is an important part of my life and Spotify helps me focus and create a mood for the project that I am working. A.I is one of the most powerful tools not only for this class but in general because it can help in areas that I am lacking and bounce ideas.
